To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
blockchain technologies can be successfully applied to the energy sector, enabling the development of a new energy market based on smart contracts.

the proposed architecture can support the deployment of an energy micro-generation market based on smart contracts, which can potentially enable new economic models for energy production and distribution.
blockchain technology can support a new, open, and more fruitful, energy micro-generation and distribution market.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (1) How to design an energy grid architecture, based on blockchain technologies, to enable a more fruitful, open, and transparent, energy micro-generation and distribution market; (2) How to design a micro-grid controller, based on blockchain, to support the energy grid architecture; (3) How to validate the architecture and the controller, through a test-bed.

(a) designing and implementing an energy grid, which is able to automatically manage energy exchanges and auctions between end-users; and (b) evaluating the impact of the proposed architecture on the energy market, in terms of economic benefits for end-users.

the development of a smart grid architecture, where the energy grid is a blockchain-based platform, which allows the automatic management of the energy exchanges between end-users and the utility, as well as the automatic auction of the energy produced by end-users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed architecture, based on blockchain and smart contracts, can support energy exchanges among micro-generators and end-users in a transparent and secure way, thus fostering the development of an open and fair energy micro-generation market.

the proposed architecture is able to support a new energy micro-generation market, in which the end-user is the key element and is able to take advantage of the energy produced by his/her micro-generation system.
the proposed solution is able to provide a more effective and efficient management of the energy micro-generation market, with a direct impact on the end-users' satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, by using smart contracts, we are able to create a new, more efficient and more profitable, energy micro-generation ecosystem.

we have designed and implemented an energy grid architecture, based on blockchain technologies, which enables end-users to directly benefit from micro-generation systems by selling their energy to the energy grid, and, in the same time, to buy cheaper energy from the grid.

we have designed a novel energy production and distribution system that can be easily integrated with existing smart grids and that can foster the development of a new, open, and transparent, energy micro-generation marketplace.
The main takeaway from our work is that
blockchain technologies can be effectively used to support the development of new, open and transparent, energy markets.
blockchain-based smart contracts are an enabling technology to support the energy micro-generation market.
smart contracts can effectively support the energy grid, enabling the development of a novel, open and transparent, energy micro-generation and distribution market.
